verdict.rationale: The IRS runs its own machine channels for a narrow slice of its services: Modernized e-File for XML return transmission and IRIS Application to Application (A2A) for information returns. Both sit behind credentialing (authorized e-file provider enrollment and a Transmitter Control Code). The other UI flows in the pack (EIN online assistant, Online Account behind ID.me biometric sign-in, online signed forms like Form 15620) show no API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API equivalents for EIN application, online account, payments, transcripts, IP PIN and signed mobile-friendly forms; a public, documented general-purpose API; a non-biometric programmatic auth path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: IRIS "receives information through two intake channels: IRIS Taxpayer Portal/UI and IRIS Application to Application (A2A)"
MeF uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format.
Online Account (OLA) is required to complete mobile friendly forms that require signatures
